No template or design system has been selected yet — use your own judgment for the visual design (a dense, functional, data-heavy admin tool, not a marketing site).

Target audience: front-desk and clinic-ops staff, not clinicians or patients. No template selected — invent a clean, calm, low-clutter visual style appropriate for a busy front desk.
